meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问如何实现某个功能，需要推荐安装技能。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how to do something and need skill recommendations.

howto.what: 当你提到某个任务时,Claude 会先查 skills.sh 榜单,再用 npx skills find 搜索技能,核实安装量与来源后报出技能名、安装命令和链接,你同意就帮你装上。
howto.when: 当你问「怎么做 X」「有没有做 X 的技能」,或表示想扩展 Claude 的能力时,它会接管这类查找与安装请求。

say.text: 帮我找一个 React 性能优化相关的技能
say.note: 它先查榜单,再搜索并核实来源

say.text: 有能帮我审查 PR 的技能吗?找到就装上
say.note: 它会给出安装命令并直接安装

say.text: 搜一下 changelog 的技能,并告诉我安装量
say.note: 会列出安装量、来源和链接

howto.what_en: When you mention a task, Claude checks the skills.sh leaderboard, searches with npx skills find, verifies install counts and source, then reports the skill name, install command and link - and can install it for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "how do I do X", "is there a skill for X", or want to extend Claude's capabilities with installable skills.

say_en.text: Help me find a skill for React performance
say_en.note: It checks the leaderboard, then searches

say_en.text: Is there a skill for reviewing PRs? Install it if so
say_en.note: It gives the command and can install it

say_en.text: Search for changelog skills and show install counts
say_en.note: It lists install counts and source
